title: anthyllis vulneraria f. rubra
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria f. rubra, commonly known as the Red Clover, is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to support bone health, reduce menopausal symptoms, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and estrogenic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as osteoporosis and menopausal hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, such as genistein and formononetin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
